resources.string: Each card sends requests to a local demo server inside this app through an OkHttpClient with PULSE attached. Open the inspector to see what was recorded. Values that look like secrets are redacted before storage.
The inspector is not available in this build (release uses pulse-noop).
200 response with an access token field and an api_key query parameter.
JSON body with a password and a Bearer Authorization header.
Client error response, recorded as a completed HTTP response.
Server error response, separate from I/O failures.
One logical request with two exchanges in the timeline.
OkHttp decompresses it; the decoded JSON is stored after redaction.
Bigger than the 512 KB body limit, so only metadata is stored.
Not JSON, so the body is not stored.
The server answers after 1.5 s but the client waits 300 ms.
The call is canceled 200 ms after it starts.
Each request keeps its own ID and response.
Six 500 responses in a row, so Issues → Network insights reports an error burst.
Sends the same unauthenticated GET six times without caching, so it shows up as a cache candidate.
application/x-www-form-urlencoded with a password. Stored with the password redacted.
/health is excluded by CaptureFilter, so it does not appear in PULSE.
Demo server inside the app · nothing leaves the device
Writes five logs from VERBOSE to ERROR with Pulse.log. See them in Timeline → App logs and filter by level.
Marks a point, then opens a span around two requests. Open the span in the Timeline tab and choose "Only this span".
Records a caught exception with Pulse.recordError. It shows up in Issues and is queued for remote reporting.
Records an error, flushes the queue, and shows how many reports the demo server\'s /collect received.
Blocks the main thread for 3 seconds. The watchdog records it as JANK. Not included in "Run all".
Throws an uncaught exception. Reopen the app: the crash and its exit reason appear in the Timeline and Issues tabs. Not included in "Run all".
The app closes right away. Open it again and check the Timeline and Issues tabs.
